answer: Proof of Agent secures the network against Sybil floods by enforcing quadratic stake burning on concurrent identities: deploying $k$ agents requires burning $O(k^2)$ collateral. While genuine nodes find an economic haven under low concurrency, an attacker targeting consensus faces superlinear cost scaling that hardens the network like a glacier. Malicious swarms dissolve rapidly into an eroded karst of wasted capital.
